parameters.name: ControlStrategyList
parameters.description: The list of security alert rules.

sub_parameters.name: ApiName
sub_parameters.description: The API name, which is the same as **ProductCode**.

sub_parameters.name: BizType
sub_parameters.description:
The rule configuration type. Valid values:
- **QPS**: QPS greater than
- **SUCCESS_RATE_5_MIN**: success rate in the last 5 minutes less than
- **RESP_TIME_5_MIN**: average response time in the last 5 minutes greater than
- **AMOUNT_RISE**: call volume increase compared to the previous period greater than
- **AMOUNT_FALL**: call volume decrease compared to the previous period less than
- **PASSED_RATE_1_HOUR**: verification consistency rate in the last hour less than
- **PARAM_ERROR_RATE_1_HOUR**: parameter error rate in the last hour greater than.

sub_parameters.name: Status
sub_parameters.description:
The status. Valid values:
- **disabled**: Disabled.
- **normal**: Enabled.

sub_parameters.name: Threshold
sub_parameters.description: The alert threshold of the rule.

parameters.name: ProductType
parameters.description: The product type. Currently, only **ANT_CLOUD_AUTH** (financial-grade ID Verification) is supported. All other types have been discontinued.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the Smart Access Gateway instance.
